slides.title: 5 affirmations your brain is quietly rejecting
slides.query: woman sitting alone thinking by window

slides.title: "I am a millionaire."
slides.body: Your brain checks your bank balance and files it under fiction.

slides.title: "I love my body."
slides.body: On a hard day, it hears a lie and argues back louder.

slides.title: "I am abundant."
slides.body: Abundant in what? There's nothing in it your mind can picture.

slides.title: "Money flows to me."
slides.body: From where? By when? A sentence with no action is a wish.

slides.title: "I attract my dream job."
slides.body: Attract it doing what, exactly? Your brain needs a next step.
slides.query: laptop on desk in quiet room

slides.title: What actually sticks
slides.body: One real goal. One thing you'll do. A day you'll do it by. "I send the 3 applications I've been avoiding. Before Friday."

slides.title: Want yours written for your goal?
slides.body: ManifestAI turns one sentence about your dream into affirmations that sound like you. Link in bio ✨
